description: Insider transactions at a Belgian listed company (managers transactions under MAR Article 19, as notified to the FSMA): are its managers buying or selling? Issuer-level aggregate over a rolling 12 months: notification counts, gross buy and sell amounts, net flow, breakdown by declarer category, plus the underlying notifications. No individual is ever named, and the breakdown is withheld when it would single someone out. A day of the window that the FSMA listing could not return whole is named in collecte_incomplete (counts are then lower bounds). Use it as a governance signal before investing in or contracting with a listed Belgian company. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

depuis.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: rolling 12 months; never earlier than five years back: older notifications are deleted, and periode.depuis_demande says when a request was bounded)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_belgian_insider_transactions

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Belgian insider transactions
